svg.title: market-sources: async scrapers for Kaspi.kz, OLX.kz and Ozon.kz behind one protocol
svg.desc: Left: the name and what it does. Right: each marketplace's anti-bot gate and what the adapter does to pass it. kaspi.kz checks the referer, PoliteClient sends a page-matching one. olx.kz fingerprints TLS, ImpersonateTransport sends Chrome's via curl_cffi. ozon.kz serves a JavaScript challenge, BrowserSession reads it through headless Chromium. A bare httpx request gets 403 on all three; every adapter returns RawProduct, RawOffer and RawReview models.
